apps.name: Jeopardy Iranian Edition
apps.subtitle: Iranian history, politics, and culture as a game show.
apps.localizedDescription:
A bilingual Iranian Jeopardy-style game with Single and Double Jeopardy, Daily Doubles, Final Jeopardy, local music, and 4,167 sourced clues in each language.

The IPA is unsigned. SideStore, AltStore, or another sideloading tool signs it with your own Apple ID.
